title: oven-roasted charred canadian toor dal
description: A charred, springy, one-pot Canadian dish featuring toor dal, roast, and whole30-friendly ingredients.
instructions: In a large Dutch oven or oven-safe pot, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the pork shoulder and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the carrots, potatoes, toor dal, salt, pepper, thyme, and rosemary. Stir to combine.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Roast for 30 minutes, then remove the lid and continue roasting for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the pork is tender and the vegetables are caramelized.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
